positions.title: Energy Consultant Intern
positions.description:
• Assisted a team of consultants in 9 different energy projects, involving market analysis, excel modelling and report writing
• Implemented a practical algorithm using Excel VBA to generate an optimal bidding strategy in electricity market for wind power generation companies
• Performed a business opportunity assessment for a utility company, including market research and comprehensive technical and financial analysis of 30 different energy conservation programs in North America

positions.title: Power System Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Reduced power system simulation and analysis time 30% by developing Python programs to automate the study process
• Assisted in transmission line outage studies on Northeastern Ontario transmission interfaces and interconnections to develop new post-contingency operating security limits
• Collaborated closely with power system engineers on a day-to-day basis and assisted in preparing power system models, data and script files
• Developed, implemented and maintained power system monitoring applications (SCADA) to assist IESO System Control Centre in ensuring reliable operation of the IESO-controlled grid

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed, tested and launched three new versions of web application, featuring a 15% faster search engine for overseas automobile parts with 13 additional filtering criteria
• Gained extensive knowledge of object oriented programming in Java and Google Web Toolkit (GWT)
• Prepared a manual for each completed project to provide guidance to end-users, system administrators and support staff
